findings: flip_probability is bound as 1 minus actual fixed-count SCAR c_realized, the estimator is rebuilt per c, and requested/realized c are recorded. KLDCE remains excluded from SAR.

The base variant is only a constructor default. The method card documents base, E and C as distinct variants and notes paper hyperparameter choices and source/EMA gaps; variant and candidate policy remain unresolved.
100 trees is a constructor default, not a frozen tree budget; the existing budget review explicitly says tree count is not an epoch budget and requires a separate storage/resource profile.

The 60+60 epoch, P/U batch 16/128 settings match the owner's 2026-10-18 partial decision. The unit is still a draft pending protocol binding, image-runner wiring and remaining resource/selection gates.
Use the method-private cnn13_no_bn image path; a frozen ResNet feature adapter would change the raw-image second-order gradient-penalty input and is not an equivalent image recipe.
Pretrain/episode defaults are not an approved budget; eligible checkpoint stages and prior/validation policy remain open.

The source-default JSD weight 0.7 is confirmed by the 2026-10-24 #122 adjudication: keep the locked source direction and its normalization denominator, register the paper Eq. (6) direction as a difference, and register the TS balanced-batch union ratio as a benchmark approximation. The ledger pointer fix is deferred to a versioned ledger update.
Constructor defaults do not resolve the paper/source sampling decision already recorded for Survey or the P4.1-B candidate and budget recipe.
Fold count and retention defaults are not an approved survey budget; OOF/refit cost remains to be frozen.
Requires clean support and the formal support path. No imdb unit is included because imdb is outside the approved support-dataset list.

Recipe frozen on 2026-10-24 by owner decision (docs/research/pu_survey/admission/genpu_126_adjudication_20261024.md): the paper prior-weighted minimax/anti-GAN objective is kept, Du fake samples are weighted pi/(1-pi), and the final PN risk is prior-weighted softplus.

The frozen recipe fixes identity output, a two-layer-256/latent-100 dense generator, linear Dp/Dn heads, two-layer-256 Du/PN heads, four independently seeded ResNet-18 stems, and the G-step freeze of D parameters/BN/dropout with input gradients kept. The three lambda weights stay 1.0: prior weighting lives in the Du mixture and the PN risk, not in those knobs. Full-data resource measurement and numeric parity remain outside this decision.

2026-10-25 owner decision: hidden_dim 128 was the constructor default left in place at freeze time, not the frozen recipe. It is now bound to the receipt value, so profile params, the genpu staged budget, the genpu_native_mlp backbone spec and genpu_recipe.py all say 256, and the profile label reads mlp256 instead of mlp128. genpu_recipe.GenPURecipeTrainer rejects any other width, so 128 was a value that could never have run.
Stage selection, initialization and storage values are constructor defaults; the P3.2 recipe blockers remain open.
The constructor OS default does not clear the native-TS calibration gate. TS calibration or an explicit inapplicability decision is still required.
Requires clean support and a dedicated runner path. No imdb unit is included because imdb is outside the approved support-dataset list.

The values match current constructor defaults, not the author recipe: the method card records 100 vs 50 epochs, batch 128 vs 500, and learning rate 3e-4 vs 3e-5. Its source validation diagnostic is not an allowed PA/OA selector under D22.

formal_blockers: The owner approved project recipes, not numerical reproduction or collaborator comparison signatures.
Per-unit full-data resource, five-seed, selection and artifact audits remain required.
New comparison mappings have no direct anchors pending independent source review.
decisions: Random frozen adapter is an engineering benchmark-adapted representation, not a trained or pretrained ResNet claim.
Native CNN and adapter rankings are strictly separate.
Full-batch Dist-PU is not budget-equivalent to mini-batch methods; unmatched oracle remains separate.
Classical methods have no MLP backbone; no neural oracle is claimed to be backbone-matched.
CIFAR-10 native-CNN PN oracle passed a real-GPU two-epoch smoke on 2026-10-22; runnable denotes implementation capability, not frozen protocol admission or completed five-seed results.
Completed-epoch weights are selected independently offline; inference checkpoints do not resume optimizer training.

PA selects on the generated pu_val view by proxy accuracy (Wang et al. 2026 Definition 1, OS branch) over the same per-checkpoint val-side min-max threshold grid OA uses; the population class prior pi is required per run (from the run's class_prior, else the split artifact's class_prior.population) and a run without it fails loudly. Formal SCAR PA acceptance remains pending the collaborator's signature.

KLDCE binds flip_probability = 1 - c for SCAR only and is rebuilt for each c; all SAR requests are rejected. Its execution rows still require approved protocol and dataset-specific budget/resource gates.
Self-PU uses two sampled optimizer steps per epoch, not a full traversal, and has no budget-matched mini-batch oracle; its comparability group is separate.
selection_spec is descriptive documentation; runner behavior is enforced by code and checkpoint tests, not by dynamically consuming this prose field.
Sampling-assumption adjudication follows the paper first; the reference code is used only when the paper is silent, and paper/code differences are registered.
Native-TS methods use TS-compatible calibration (D_U <- D_U union D_P) on OS data; this is not TS data resampling.
The canonical prior is population pi; pi_U = pi under the ts view and pi_U = (pi*n - n_L)/(n - n_L) under the SCAR os view.
Architecture exceptions are limited to architectures or recipes required by the method mechanism or the paper; author-code implementation choices are not exceptions.
The main table defaults to PA selection; OA configurations are recorded for reference (Q2).
Architecture-exception methods remain single-listed; a shared-architecture comparison run SHOULD be provided when feasible, and its absence is noted in the result table/method card (Q1).
PA+clean-support results are listed in the same SCAR-PA table with an explicit annotation and are excluded from pure-PU PA advantage comparisons (Q3).

Training-time clean support is required by PULNS, LaGAM, and the full Self-PU branch; the no-clean Self-PU path is an explicit ablation. Support is disjoint from the remaining train, pu_val, clean_val, and test; this round carves it from train and removes it, sized 100 for Spambase and 500 otherwise, and its positive and negative labels count toward the training-time label budget (approved 2026-10-21).
This round covers Spambase, Connect-4, MNIST, F-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 only; IMDB, 20News, and ADNI are excluded from PA+clean-support.

The formal PA+clean-support runner landed with the 2026-10-24 v3 freeze; support-dependent rows report PA+clean-support alongside OA, annotated and excluded from pure-PU PA advantage comparisons. Existing self_pu execution units retain the no-meta ablation profile.
method_profiles.self_pu remains the explicit no-meta ablation profile used by the frozen pilot; the full clean-meta variant uses the separate self_pu_full_meta profile and its own support unit.

Clean-support units on the two image datasets take the shared ResNet-18 end to end for LaGAM and PULNS; Self-PU full-meta takes the frozen feature adapter because its estimator has no native CNN (D5), matching its existing mnist/fashion_mnist rows. The support part is carried through the same image preprocessing, so it is no longer handed to the estimator as raw uint8 pixels or as 4-D images on a 2-D path.

2026-11-01: owner adopts current provisional project recipes, including P3MIX base/default role_balanced batching. Historical merged_shuffle candidate results remain separate. VPU/CVIR cpu_stream preserves full batches/epochs. SAR is an OA-only stress test, not a claim of new selection-bias correction.
